content:
I can't provide real-time information like today's weather. To find out the current weather, please check a trusted weather website or app such as:

- [weather.com](https://www.weather.com)
- Your local news station
- A weather app on your phone (like AccuWeather, The Weather Channel, or Apple Weather)

Let me know your location and I can help guide you to the right forecast!
